summary: Kevin Buckelew is a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology who studied at Sarah Lawrence College and Columbia University (PhD 2018). In 2018, he became an assistant professor at Northwestern University.

Kevin Vogelaar works in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. After degrees at SUNY New Paltz, Fordham, and Tufts, he held posts at Fordham, Tufts as graduate assistant research curator, and the Armenian Museum of America.
Kexin Zheng is a scholar in Indology and religious studies who is attested in 2026 as a PhD candidate at Leiden University, studying under doctoral supervisor Peter C. Bisschop.

Khakyab Dorje (1871–1922) was a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under teachers including Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye and Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and taught numerous students, including Kalu Rinpoche and Karsé Kongtrul.
Kham Sum Zilnön Gyepa Dorjé studied under Shenphen Nangwa and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He also taught Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö.

Khammai Dhammasami is a Buddhist studies scholar who earned a DPhil from Oxford (~2000–2004). He served at Oxford, ITBMU, and Oxford Buddha Vihara around 2003, and later founded Shan State Buddhist University in 2014.
Khanderao Deshpande was an Indology scholar who completed doctoral studies under Moriz Winternitz. He served as Joint Director at Osmania University, attested in 1969.
Khangsar Tenpe Wangchuk (1938–2014) was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under the traditional teachers Jampal Gyepe Dorje and Lodro Gyatso.
Khen Gen Jampal Dorjé studied under Shenphen Nangwa and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.
Khenchen Ngawang Khyen Rab Gyatso studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche and Trulshik Rinpoche.

Khenchen Palden Sherab Rinpoche (1938–2010) was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied at Gochen and Riwoche monasteries, later chairing the Nyingma section at the Central Institute of Higher Tibetan Studies (~1967–1984).
Khenchen Tashi Özer studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye. He taught Khakyab Dorje and Shechen Gyaltsab.

Khenchen Thrangu Rinpoche (1933–2023) was a scholar of Buddhist studies, Tibetology, and philosophy. He studied under Khenpo Gangshar and the 16th Karmapa, served as abbot at Rumtek, Karma Shri Nalanda, and Gampo Abbey, and founded several monasteries.
Khenchen Tsewang Rigdzin studied under teachers including Shenphen Nangwa, Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Shechen Gyaltsab, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso.
Khenpo Appey Rinpoche (1927–2010) was a scholar in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at Dzongsar Monastery under Drakgyab Lodrö and served as Director of Sakya College from 1972 to 1985.
Khenpo Dazer was a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology who studied under Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima. He served as a teacher at both Śrī Siṃha Shedra and the Ngagyur Nyingma Institute.

Khenpo Gangshar (1925–1980) worked in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Shechen Monastery under teachers including Khyentse Ozer and Shechen Kongtrul, serving as senior teacher there and founding dean at Surmang Monastery (~1957–1958).

Khenpo Jigme Phuntsok (1933–2004) was a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under teachers including Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima and Ba Tur Khenpo Tubten Chö Pel, and taught numerous students.

Khenpo Karthar Rinpoche (1924–2019) was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology scholar who studied at Thrangu Monastery. He taught at Rumtek Monastery in 1967 and became abbot of Karma Triyana Dharmachakra in 1978.
Khenpo Konchog Gyaltsen Rinpoche (born 1946) is a scholar in Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied under traditional teachers Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen, Khyunga Rinpoche, and Pachung Rinpoche.
